{{Quote|A major terrorist network lies in tatters this morning following the end of a massive overnight operation by Coruscant Security Forces. A total of ninety-seven suspects were detained or killed, and what's described as 'a significant amount' of explosives seized. Senator Ihu Niopua described it as a magnificent piece of police work and praised officers.|HoloNet News and Entertainment|<ref name="Republic Commando: Triple Zero">''[[Republic Commando: Triple Zero]]''</ref>}}
A '''Separatist terrorist network''' was in operation on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. The [[Terrorist/Legends|terrorists]] were responsible for attacks against the Republic such as the [[Depot Bravo Five terrorist attack|attack]] on [[Depot Bravo Five]]. The terrorist network was brought down by a [[Mission to Coruscant (Clone Wars)|joint operation]] between the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic's]] [[Special Operations Brigade/Legends|Special Operations Brigade]] and the [[Coruscant Security Force/Legends|Coruscant Security Force's]] [[Anti-Terrorism Unit]] and [[Organized Crime Unit]].
